author: Valley City Times-Record
title: CoreAge Rx Expands Prescription Skincare Lineup with Launch of Smooth Move Anti-Aging Treatment
text:
Dermatological formula pairs Tretinoin, Niacinamide, and Vitamin C for comprehensive nighttime skin rejuvenation.
Digital health provider CoreAge Rx today announced the official release of Smooth Move, an all-in-one prescription anti-aging topical engineered to boost skin renewal, soften fine lines, and restore natural radiance. By combining three clinically backed active ingredients into a single application, the new formulation provides a streamlined approach for individuals targeting dullness, uneven texture, and early signs of aging.
Smooth Move is anchored by prescription-strength Tretinoin, a proven retinoid that stimulates cell turnover, encourages collagen production, and refines rough skin texture. To balance the potent exfoliating action of Tretinoin, the formula incorporates Niacinamide to soothe redness, reinforce the skin's moisture barrier, and evening out skin tone. The addition of Vitamin C helps neutralize dullness and promote a noticeably brighter complexion.
Designed for simple integration into nightly self-care routines, Smooth Move is applied as a thin layer on clean, dry skin under the guidance of a prescribing clinician. Because the formula features medical-grade active ingredients, healthcare providers typically advise patients to introduce the product gradually to build tolerance. Daytime application of broad-spectrum sunscreen is strongly recommended throughout treatment.
Patients can request Smooth Move directly through the CoreAge Rx telehealth portal. The process begins with a private online health evaluation, which is thoroughly reviewed by a US board-certified physician. Once approved, the personalized prescription is compounded in the United States and delivered straight to the patient's door. CoreAge Rx maintains flat-rate pricing starting at $42 per month, which includes ongoing care and shipping with no required contracts or hidden membership fees.
This expansion underscores CoreAge Rx’s mission to make high-grade, physician-guided skincare accessible and affordable. In addition to telehealth consultations and doorstep delivery, members gain access to round-the-clock clinical support and a dedicated patient community throughout their care.
For a deeper look into how combining active ingredients simplifies daily routines, read the full feature on The Science of Modern Anti-Aging: How CoreAge Rx Smooth Move Is Streamlining Prescription Skincare .
Explore the product details at https://www.coreagerx.com/product/smooth-move/
About CoreAge Rx
CoreAge Rx is a digital health platform that connects individuals with licensed medical professionals and coordinates direct delivery of prescription treatments. Focusing on personalized care across metabolic wellness and targeted dermatology, CoreAge Rx delivers accessible health solutions designed for modern daily life.
For more information, visit coreagerx.com
